verdict.rationale: HumanLayer's release notes document pasting images directly into the new task composer as attachments, so a developer can attach a screenshot or mockup to a task. That single release-note line is the only evidence. Nothing shows annotation or markup support, how the image reaches the agent, or that it guides visual implementation. Missing for 10: in-product markup/annotation of screenshots, documentation that attached images are passed to and used by the agent for implementation, attachment on existing tasks or comments, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attach a marked-up screenshot or mockup to a task so the agent implements the correct visual change

citations.quote: Image paste in new tasks — Paste images straight into the new task composer as attachments.
